verdict.rationale: ADK's Workflow Runtime explicitly supports fan-out/fan-in and loops, which are the mechanisms needed to process many items in bulk within an agent workflow, and workflows can orchestrate multiple agents/tasks. However, there's no concrete example, tutorial, or built-in tool specifically demonstrating bulk operations across many items (e.g., batch data processing at scale). Missing for 10: a documented bulk-processing example/tutorial, evidence of scale/performance handling for large item counts, and independent corroboration of this pattern in practice.
